turn.user_message: What about the bed after the patient leaves?
turn.context: Automations place, turn 7 (the hand-over to the bed, each side checking the other).

text: The discharge does not end at the door. Today the bed stays empty 75 minutes before the next patient can use it.
bullets: Housekeeping hears late, so cleaning starts late.
The bed desk learns a bed is free only when someone calls.
Nobody checks the other side’s times. So a late discharge can be written down as an early one.
chat.invite: Next, we can look at how the day changes on the wards.
chat.note: A discharge ends when the next patient is in the bed.
prompts: Who at the bed desk would see this?
Where do the automations stand now?
chat.pointer: Switch between today and both sides linked. Pick a step to open it.

blocks.title: The bed is the last step
blocks.deck: From the patient leaving to the next patient in the bed, on both sides.

blocks.hint: Pick a step of the hand-over. Switch to see it with both sides linked.
blocks.condition: Past 30 minutes, the hand-over is slow, or a time is not what really happened. This check needs the bed desk’s own times.

sheets.title: Patient leaves the ward
sheets.text: The ward marks the leaving time on the phone. Tojo passes it on at once.
sheets.entry: Who records the leaving time today?

sheets.title: Housekeeping hears
sheets.text: Housekeeping gets an alert with the bed number and the time.

sheets.title: Bed cleaned and made
sheets.text: Housekeeping marks the bed clean on their phone when it is done.
sheets.entry: How long does a clean take?

sheets.title: Bed shown as ready
sheets.text: The bed desk sees the bed turn ready, without a phone call.
sheets.entry: How does the bed desk see a ready bed?

sheets.title: Next patient in the bed
sheets.text: The time the next patient arrives is recorded. Both sides check each other’s times.
sheets.entry: When does the next patient usually arrive?

blocks.label: Bed empty after leaving
blocks.sub: Your own number. The goal is under 30 minutes, checked by both sides.
